links.outcome: Share of LLM imaging recommendations rated optimal per ACR criteria across eight models
links.effect: Optimal recommendations varied widely: GPT4 23/24, ChatGPT 20/24, Perplexity 19/24, Claude 19/24, Bard 1 13/24, Bard 2 14/24, Bing Chat 14/24, Llama 5/24.
links.quote: The models varied in their ability to deliver an "optimal" recommendation based on these scenarios as follows: ChatGPT (20/24), GPT4 (23/24), Bard 1 (13/24), Bard 2 (14/24), Bing Chat (14/24), Llama (5/24), Perplexity (19/24), and Claude (19/24).

screen.reason: Evaluates and compares the performance/accuracy of eight public LLMs on 24 neuroradiology clinical vignette scenarios against clinical criteria, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
